name: Tehillim app
description: A mobile app that allows users to read Tehillim

descriptions: Leveraged a React Native component to efficiently render and display static data.
Created an interactive app that features dark/light mode, chapter bookmarking, chapter indexing, and language selection.
Implemented a custom navigation bar that allows users to easily navigate between chapters.
Added a search functionality to quickly find specific chapters or verses.
Integrated a local storage solution to save user preferences and bookmarks.
Designed a responsive UI that adapts to different screen sizes and orientations.
Included a settings page where users can customize the app's appearance and behavior.
Optimized the app for performance to ensure smooth scrolling and quick loading times.
Implemented accessibility features such as text-to-speech and adjustable font sizes.

name: E CHABOT
description: A Fullstack internal business system for a jewelry business

descriptions: Built an internal business management system using React for the frontend and Supabase for the backend.
The workflow starts with a business idea, which is turned into a design. Staff can then generate quotes for the design, and once approved, it moves into sample production and sales tracking.
Business workers can view and manage orders using three methods: a live preview link, an Excel export, or a downloadable PDF.
Supabase’s PostgreSQL database required extensive use of relational tables to handle users, designs, quotes, samples, orders, and file storage.
Implemented complex relationships and logic in Supabase to ensure smooth transitions between each business stage and maintain data integrity.
Used Supabase authentication and row-level security to manage staff access and permissions throughout the system.
Integrated real-time updates so that business workers always see the latest status of each order and project.
Automated document generation (Excel and PDF) directly from the database, ensuring accuracy and consistency for internal reporting.
Designed the React frontend to be intuitive for staff, with dynamic forms and dashboards reflecting the current state of each project.
Worked closely with the business team to refine workflows and ensure the system matched real-world internal processes.

name: Rentoscope
description: A Real estate analysis platform for investors

descriptions: RentoScope, a data-driven web platform designed to help rental property investors analyze and evaluate real estate investment opportunities more efficiently.
The platform was built with React for the frontend and Supabase (PostgreSQL) for the backend, enabling a scalable architecture capable of supporting complex investment data and analytics.

Designed and implemented an interactive investment analysis dashboard that allows users to review property performance metrics, organize potential deals, and compare opportunities in one centralized workspace.
Architected a relational PostgreSQL database structure to manage properties, financial metrics, saved analyses, user accounts, and investment scenarios while maintaining strong data integrity.
Implemented secure authentication and row-level security (RLS) through Supabase to ensure user data isolation and secure access across the platform.
Built dynamic financial modeling tools that allow investors to quickly estimate potential cash flow, expenses, and overall investment performance.
Designed the platform to consolidate information that investors often manage across multiple spreadsheets, notes, and external tools, improving workflow efficiency and decision-making.
Developed a responsive and intuitive user interface that simplifies complex real estate data into actionable insights for investors.
Engineered the system with scalability in mind, allowing future integration of additional analytics, market data, and advanced property evaluation tools.
Worked closely with stakeholders to ensure the platform addressed real-world investment workflows, focusing on clarity, speed of analysis, and usability for property investors.
Please visit the website at rentoscope.com to view the full functionality of the site.
